doc_requests.documents: Because the account would be funded and operated by your relative Ilhan Adler, bank policy (beneficial ownership rules) requires us to identify and verify the beneficial owner before opening: (1) a valid government-issued ID for Ilhan Adler; (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration; (3) documented source of funds for Ilhan Adler's funds. Please note we cannot open the account solely in your name as a nominee — the person who owns and controls the funds must be the account holder or be fully identified and verified.
